$comment: The tools of this server that the Personal Assistant in mctlhq/mctl-telegram pins (servers.alice.tools in internal/pa/catalog/pin.json there), with the fields the PA compares at run time. description_sha256, input_schema_sha256 and annotations use the same canonical form as that pin and must equal its values for the same tool; description and input_schema are the readable source of the two hashes. tests/pa-pinned-tools.test.ts fails when a pinned tool is changed, removed or stops accepting required_scope. Updating this file is the acknowledgement that the pin in mctl-telegram is refreshed as well: see docs/runbooks/tool-surface.md.

alice_get_device_history.description: Get historical telemetry time-series, energy consumption (total kWh, peak/min/average power in Watts), and sensor charts for a smart home device. Works only on a self-hosted single-user server, which samples devices every minute; the hosted service (alice.mctl.ai) does not record history and returns an error.

room.description: Room name where the device is located (e.g. 'Кухня', 'Спальня').

metric.description: Telemetry metric to retrieve: 'power' (Watts & kWh), 'voltage', 'amperage', 'temperature', 'humidity', 'pressure', 'battery_level', 'on_off', or 'all'. Defaults to 'power'.

from.description: Start of time range (ISO 8601 string e.g. '2026-09-20T00:00:00+02:00', or 'today', '24h', '7d'). Defaults to start of today.

to.description: End of time range (ISO 8601 string or 'now'). Defaults to current time.

resolution.description: Aggregation resolution: 'max' (or '1m') returns raw 1-minute samples; '5m', '15m', or '1h' groups by average to keep response compact.

alice_get_device_state.description: Get real-time status and telemetry of any smart home device (socket power in Watts, voltage, current, climate sensor temperature, humidity, pressure, battery level, or on/off state) via official Yandex IoT API.

room.description: Room name where the device is located (e.g. 'Кухня', 'Детская'). Helpful when multiple devices share the same name.

alice_get_home_summary.description: Get a single comprehensive status overview and health dashboard of the smart home (or a specific room): climate conditions (°C, humidity, pressure), security sensors (door open/closed, motion, illumination), lighting status, active sockets & power draw (Watts), and sensor battery levels.

room.description: Optional room name to filter summary (e.g. 'Кухня', 'Спальня'). If omitted, returns summary for the whole home.

alice_list_devices.description: List all Yandex Alice smart speakers, rooms, and devices in the user's smart home. Use this to discover available speakers and their IDs.

only_speakers.description: If true, only returns Alice smart speakers. Defaults to false.
